meta.name: run-train
meta.description: Rigor Train skill for deep learning research repositories. Use when a documented or selected training command should be run conservatively for startup verification, short-run verification, full kickoff, or resume, with command, config, seed, log, checkpoint, status, and metric evidence written to standardized `train_outputs/`. Do not use for environment setup, exploratory sweeps, speculative idea implementation, or end-to-end orchestration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把深度学习训练跑起来,并留存日志、检查点与指标
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手里有深度学习训练仓库,想让每次训练都跑得可复现、可查证。
copy.tagline_en: Run deep learning training with logs, checkpoints, and metrics saved
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a deep learning repo and want every training run reproducible and auditable

howto.what: 执行已选定的训练命令（启动验证、短跑验证、正式启动或续跑），把命令、配置、随机种子、日志、检查点、状态与指标写入统一的 train_outputs/ 目录。
howto.when: 当训练命令已选定并需要保守执行时触发，例如启动验证、短跑验证、正式启动等模式。

say.text: 用 run-train 对这条训练命令做启动验证
say.note: 保守启动，证据写入 train_outputs/

say.text: 对已选定的训练命令做短跑验证，并记录指标
从上次检查点续跑训练，并更新状态

howto.what_en: Runs a selected training command conservatively for startup verification, short-run verification, full kickoff, or resume, writing command, config, seed, log, checkpoint, status, and metric evidence to standardized train_outputs/.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a training command is already selected and should be run conservatively, e.g. startup verification, short-run verification, or full kickoff.

say_en.text: Run a startup verification of this training command with run-train
say_en.note: Starts conservatively and writes train_outputs/ evidence

say_en.text: Do a short-run verification of the selected training command
Resume training from the last checkpoint and update the status
